title: Sticky coding sessions should route engineering turns to the dedicated coder profile
body: Implement a sticky coding-session manager for the tri-mode model architecture. Explicit enter/exit commands should control coding mode, the mode should idle out after the configured timeout, watched games must lock out the heavy coder, and status/start/stop routes should report the state.
interface: createCodingSessionManager exposes explicit start/stop/status behaviour, and /coding-session routes reflect it.
why: Self-work needs stable engineering-mode routing without profile ping-pong between follow-up turns.
